targets.review_note: For a permutation, an interval is good exactly when max-min-length+1=0; this expression is never negative. Sweep right endpoints and use monotone stacks to apply range changes to all left-endpoint scores. A segment tree tracks the current minimum/multiplicity and accumulated zero occurrences per left endpoint. Propagate historical-minimum ticks before structural changes. Offline suffix history queries count all good intervals fully inside each requested range.

targets.review_note: Introduce virtual nodes for lighting a row or column. A lit cell can pay1 to enter its own or an adjacent line, and that line reaches initially lit cells on or adjacent to it for free. Adjacent initially lit cells also have zero edges. An unlit destination is reachable only through its exact row/column, not through an adjacent line. Zero-one BFS finds cost with O(n+m+k) edges and respects switching only at initially lit cells.

targets.review_note: Prime-operation distance is Omega(a)+Omega(b)-2Omega(gcd(a,b)). For every divisor retain the two source indices minimizing(Omega(value),index). Enumerating divisors of a finds its nearest other source via a shared divisor, with the gcd among those choices guaranteeing equality. Two candidates exclude self without losing ties; duplicate values have distance0 and are handled by original index order.

targets.review_note: Discard duplicate/contained observations without changing required passwords, then build an Aho-Corasick automaton carrying occurrence masks. Memoized remaining-length/state/mask counts all26-letter continuations, grouping characters with identical transitions. Once all observations are present, count26^remaining directly. Only when the exact total is at most42, traverse viable transitions in alphabetic order to enumerate every password.

targets.review_note: Reduce fixed pattern cells modulo the torus dimensions; contradictory requirements on the same cyclic cell immediately rule out all placements. Store a bitmask of columns for each letter in each table row. Rotating each mask by a pattern offset yields all compatible starting columns simultaneously, and intersecting them gives exact matches. Wildcards impose no constraints and early-empty intersections avoid unnecessary work.

targets.review_note: Changing a suffix costs k minus the common-prefix length, so minimize cost by maximizing total LCP in a multiset matching. Build a suffix array/LCP for both source strings, mark only starts with at least k characters in their own string, and join neighboring suffix components in descending capped LCP order. Match opposite unmatched counts at each merge; prefix clusters are nested, so deepest-first pairing is optimal and handles duplicate substrings correctly.
